issues.message: Keterkaitan otomatis: nama berkas, deskripsi berkas, kategori "Minotaur in ancient Greek pottery", dipakai di bcl.wikipedia.org: Minotaur. Cek visual tetap diperlukan.

claims.statement: The Minotaur, also known as Asterion or Asterius, was depicted in classical antiquity with the head and tail of a bull and the body of a man.
claims.statement_id: Minotaur juga dikenal sebagai Asterion atau Asterius, digambarkan pada zaman klasik dengan kepala dan ekor banteng serta tubuh manusia.
claims.quote: also known as Asterion or Asterius , is a mythical creature portrayed during classical antiquity with the head and tail of a bull and the body of a man

claims.statement: Queen Pasiphae had Daedalus fashion a hollow wooden cow in order to mate with the bull.
claims.statement_id: Ratu Pasiphae menyuruh pembuat ulung Daedalus membuatkan sapi kayu berongga agar dapat berpasangan dengan banteng.
claims.quote: Pasiphaë had the master craftsman , Daedalus , fashion for her a hollow wooden cow, into which she climbed to let the bull mate with her.

claims.statement: Pasiphae nursed the Minotaur, but he grew in size and became ferocious.
claims.statement_id: Pasiphae menyusui Minotaur namun sang makhluk tumbuh membesar dan menjadi sangat buas.
claims.quote: Pasiphaë nursed the Minotaur but he grew in size and became ferocious.

claims.statement: King Minos, following the Delphic oracle, had Daedalus construct a gigantic Labyrinth to imprison the Minotaur.
claims.statement_id: Raja Minos mengikuti petunjuk orakel Delphi dan menyuruh Daedalus membangun labirin raksasa untuk menahan Minotaur.
claims.quote: Minos, following advice from the oracle at Delphi , had Daedalus construct a gigantic Labyrinth to hold the Minotaur.

claims.statement: The sacrificial tribute of young Athenian men and women was paid as a penalty for the death of Androgeus.
claims.statement_id: Pengorbanan pemuda dan pemudi Athena dilakukan sebagai tebusan atas kematian Androgeus putra Minos.
claims.quote: The sacrifice of young Athenian men and women was a penalty for his death.

claims.statement: He dwelt at the center of the Labyrinth, which was an elaborate maze-like construction.
claims.statement_id: Minotaur tinggal di tengah Labirin yang merupakan bangunan berliku seperti lorong sesat.
claims.quote: He dwelt at the center of the Labyrinth , which was an elaborate maze -like construction

claims.statement: In Greek mythology of ancient Greece, the Minotaur was a monster with the body of a man and the head and tail of a bull.
claims.statement_id: Dalam mitologi Yunani di Greece, Minotaur adalah monster dengan tubuh manusia serta kepala dan ekor banteng.
claims.quote: In Greek mythology , the Minotaur was a monster with the body of a man and the head and tail of a bull.

claims.statement: The Minotaur was the offspring of Cretan Queen Pasiphae and a majestic bull.
claims.statement_id: Minotaur adalah keturunan Ratu Kreta Pasiphae dan seekor banteng megah.
claims.quote: The Minotaur was the offspring of the Cretan Queen Pasiphae and a majestic bull.

claims.statement: Due to the Minotaur monstrous form, King Minos ordered Daedalus and Icarus to build the Labyrinth to house the beast.
claims.statement_id: Karena wujudnya yang menyeramkan, Raja Minos memerintahkan Daedalus dan Icarus membangun Labirin untuk menampung sang monster.
claims.quote: Due to the Minotaur's monstrous form, King Minos ordered the craftsman, Daedalus , and his son, Icarus, to build a huge maze known as the Labyrinth to house the beast.

claims.statement: The Minotaur remained in the Labyrinth receiving annual offerings of youths and maidens to eat.
claims.statement_id: Minotaur berdiam di dalam Labirin menerima upeti tahunan pemuda dan pemudi untuk dimangsa.
claims.quote: The Minotaur remained in the Labyrinth receiving annual offerings of youths and maidens to eat.

claims.statement: He was eventually killed by the Athenian hero Theseus.
claims.statement_id: Minotaur pada akhirnya berhasil dibunuh oleh pahlawan Theseus.
claims.quote: He was eventually killed by the Athenian hero Theseus .

claims.statement: The word Minotaur is a compound word from Minos and tauros, meaning bull of Minos.
claims.statement_id: Kata Minotaur adalah kata majemuk dari nama Minos dan kata tauros yang bermakna banteng Minos.
claims.quote: The word Minotaur is a compound word consisting of the ancient Greek name " Μίνως" or "Minos" and the noun " ταύρος" or "bull." Thus, the word Minotaur comes to mean "bull of Minos."

claims.statement: The Minotaur birth name Asterion means starry one, suggesting an association with the bull constellation Taurus.
claims.statement_id: Nama lahir Minotaur yakni Asterion berarti yang berbintang dan mengindikasikan kaitan dengan rasi bintang Taurus.
claims.quote: While, the Minotaur's birth name, Asterion, in ancient Greek " ἀστέριον " means "starry one" which suggests an association with the bull constellation: Taurus.

claims.statement: Theseus used a ball of thread tied to the entrance door to find his way out of the maze.
claims.statement_id: Theseus menggunakan gulungan benang yang diikatkan ke pintu labirin untuk menemukan jalan keluar kembali.
claims.quote: ball of thread to help him find his way out of the Labyrinth. Upon entering the Labyrinth, Theseus tied one end of the string to the door and continued into the maze

claims.statement: The Minotauros was a bull-headed monster born to Queen Pasiphae of Crete.
claims.statement_id: Minotauros adalah monster berkepala banteng yang dilahirkan dari Ratu Pasiphae di Kreta.
claims.quote: THE MINOTAUROS (Minotaur) was a bull-headed monster born to Queen Pasiphae of Krete (Crete).

claims.statement: The creature lived in the maze-like corridors of the labyrinth, receiving regular offerings to satisfy its hunger.
claims.statement_id: Makhluk ini hidup di lorong berliku labirin dan menerima persembahan berkala untuk memuaskan rasa laparnya.
claims.quote: The creature lived in the maze-like corridors of the labyrinth, receiving regular offerings meant to satisfy its relentless hunger.

claims.statement: The beast was eventually slain by the hero Theseus.
claims.statement_id: Monster tersebut pada akhirnya dibinasakan oleh sang pahlawan Theseus.
claims.quote: The beast was eventually slain by the hero Theseus.

claims.statement: The Minotauros proper name Asterion, the starry one, suggests an association with the constellation Tauros.
claims.statement_id: Nama diri Minotauros yaitu Asterion bermakna yang berbintang dan mengaitkannya dengan rasi bintang Tauros.
claims.quote: The Minotauros' proper name Asterion, "the starry one," suggests he might have been associated with the constellation Tauros.

claims.statement: An oni is a kind of yōkai, demon, or ogre in Japanese folklore of Japan.
claims.statement_id: Oni adalah sejenis yōkai, demon, atau ogre dalam cerita rakyat Jepang.
claims.quote: is a kind of yōkai, demon, orc, ogre, or troll in Japanese folklore.

claims.statement: They are believed to live in caves, deep within mountains, or in hell.
claims.statement_id: Oni dipercaya hidup di dalam gua, jauh di pedalaman gunung, atau di neraka.
claims.quote: They are believed to live in caves , deep within mountains , or in hell .

claims.statement: Oni are known for superhuman strength and associated with thunder and lightning.
claims.statement_id: Oni dikenal memiliki kekuatan manusia super dan dikaitkan dengan kekuatan petir dan kilat.
claims.quote: Oni are known for their superhuman strength and have been associated with powers like thunder and lightning,

claims.statement: They are typically portrayed as hulking figures with horns, massive teeth, and occasionally a third eye.
claims.statement_id: Oni umumnya digambarkan bertubuh kekar dengan satu atau lebih tanduk, gigi taring besar, dan kadang mata ketiga.
claims.quote: They are typically portrayed as hulking figures with one or more horns growing out of their heads, massive teeth, and occasionally a third eye in the center of the forehead.

claims.statement: They are depicted with red, blue, black, or yellow skin, wearing tiger pelt loincloths, and carrying iron kanabō clubs.
claims.statement_id: Oni berpenampilan kulit merah, biru, hitam, atau kuning, mengenakan cawat kulit macan, serta membawa gada kanabō.
claims.quote: They are typically depicted with red, blue, black, or yellow colored skin, wearing loincloths of tiger pelt , and carrying iron kanabō clubs.

claims.statement: The Setsubun festival involves people casting roasted soybeans outside their homes and shouting to drive away oni.
claims.statement_id: Festival Setsubun melibatkan warga melempar kacang kedelai sangrai ke luar rumah sambil berseru mengusir oni.
claims.quote: It involves people casting roasted soybeans indoors or out of their homes and shouting " Oni wa soto! Fuku wa uchi! " ( "鬼は外！福は内！" ; "Oni outside! Blessings inside!")

claims.statement: Oni are creatures who cause mischief and disaster, although they can be converted to the right path.
claims.statement_id: Oni adalah makhluk tanpa moral pembuat malapetaka dan bencana, meskipun dapat dibimbing ke jalan yang benar.
claims.quote: Oni , or demons, are creatures just about everywhere who, without morals, cause mischief and disaster, although, they can be converted to the right path.

claims.statement: The number of oni greatly increased following the introduction of Buddhism into Japan from the 6th century CE.
claims.statement_id: Kisah mengenai oni semakin berkembang pesat setelah masuknya ajaran Buddha ke Jepang sejak abad ke-6 Masehi.
claims.quote: The number of oni was greatly increased following the introduction of Buddhism into Japan from the 6th century CE onwards.

claims.statement: There are two types of oni: those dwelling in the underworld with red or green bodies and those in the heavens.
claims.statement_id: Terdapat dua jenis oni yakni penghuni neraka bawah dan penghuni langit, di mana penghuni neraka berbadan merah atau hijau.
claims.quote: There are two types of oni , those which dwell in the underworld and those in the heavens. The former type usually have a red or green body, the head of a horse or ox, and ride a flaming chariot .

claims.statement: Their job is to take souls down to hell, while other oni have no physical form but can be heard.
claims.statement_id: Tugas sebagian oni adalah menyeret jiwa ke neraka, sementara yang lain tak berwujud fisik namun dapat didengar suaranya.
claims.quote: Their job is to take souls down to hell. Other oni have no physical form but can be heard when they speak, sing or whistle.

claims.statement: Some oni were linked with diseases, while jealous women were believed to transform into demons.
claims.statement_id: Sebagian oni dikaitkan dengan penyakit atau merasuki hewan, dan diyakini wanita pencemburu dapat berubah menjadi siluman.
claims.quote: Some oni were associated with specific diseases, some were thought to possess animals which can then possess people (especially the fox or racoon), and it was believed that women ruled by jealousy or without feelings were transformed into demons.

claims.statement: Oni can be banished or eliminated by spells and rituals performed by those in the know.
claims.statement_id: Oni dapat diusir atau dilenyapkan dengan mantra dan ritual persembahyangan.
claims.quote: Oni and most other supernatural beings can sometimes offer gifts and teach people skills, so too, they can be banished or eliminated by spells and rituals performed by those in the know.

claims.statement: Oni are icons of Japanese folklore, large and scary, standing taller than the tallest man.
claims.statement_id: Oni merupakan ikon besar cerita rakyat Jepang, berukuran sangat besar dan lebih tinggi dari manusia tertinggi.
claims.quote: Oni are one the greatest icons of Japanese folklore. They are large and scary, standing taller than the tallest man, and sometimes taller than trees.

claims.statement: They are commonly depicted with red or blue skin, wild hair, two or more horns, and fang-like tusks.
claims.statement_id: Oni umumnya digambarkan berkulit merah atau biru, rambut liar, dua tanduk atau lebih, serta taring tajam.
claims.quote: They come in many varieties, but are most commonly depicted with red or blue skin, wild hair, two or more horns, and fang-like tusks.

claims.statement: All oni possess extreme strength, are accomplished sorcerers, spread disease, and punish the damned in hell.
claims.statement_id: Semua oni memiliki kekuatan fisik hebat, mampu menyihir, membawa bencana, penyakit, dan menghukum pendosa di neraka.
claims.quote: All oni possess extreme strength and constitution, and many of them are accomplished sorcerers. They are ferocious demons, bringers of disaster, spreaders of disease, and punishers of the damned in hell.

claims.statement: Oni are born when wicked humans die and become brutal servants of Great Lord Enma, ruler of hell.
claims.statement_id: Oni lahir ketika manusia jahat mati dan masuk ke neraka Buddha, menjadi pelayan Great Lord Enma penguasa neraka.
claims.quote: Oni are born when truly wicked humans die and end up in one of the many Buddhist hells. Transformed into oni, they become the ogreish and brutal servants of Great Lord Enma, ruler of hell.

claims.statement: Wielding great iron clubs, they crush and destroy humans solely for enjoyment.
claims.statement_id: Bersenjatakan gada besi besar, mereka meremukkan dan menghancurkan manusia.
claims.quote: Wielding great iron clubs, they crush and destroy humans solely for enjoyment.

claims.statement: An oni job is to mete out horrible punishments such as peeling off skins and crushing bones.
claims.statement_id: Tugas oni adalah menimpakan hukuman mengerikan seperti menguliti dan meremukkan tulang arwah pendosa.
claims.quote: job is to mete out horrible punishments such as peeling off skins, crushing bones, and rendering other torments too horrible to describe.

claims.statement: The name Quetzalcoatl originates from Nahuatl and means precious serpent or feathered serpent.
claims.statement_id: Nama Quetzalcoatl berasal dari bahasa Nahuatl yang berarti ular berharga atau ular berbulu unggas.
claims.quote: The name Quetzalcoatl comes from Nahuatl and means "Precious serpent" or " Quetzal -feathered Serpent".

claims.statement: In the Maya culture, he was roughly equivalent to Kukulkan and Gukumatz, meaning feathered serpent.
claims.statement_id: Di wilayah kebudayaan Maya, ia dipadankan dengan Kukulkan dan Gukumatz yang juga bermakna ular berbulu.
claims.quote: In the Maya area he was approximately equivalent to Kukulkan and Gukumatz , names that also roughly translate as "feathered serpent" in different Mayan languages .

claims.statement: Quetzalcoatl presided over the West as the White Tezcatlipoca, the god of light, justice, mercy, and wind.
claims.statement_id: Quetzalcoatl menguasai arah barat sebagai Tezcatlipoca Putih, dewa cahaya, keadilan, belas kasih, dan angin.
claims.quote: Over the West presides the White Tezcatlipoca, Quetzalcoatl, the god of light, justice, mercy and wind.

claims.statement: Quetzalcoatl wore the wind jewel breastplate known as ehecacozcatl, fashioned from a sliced conch shell.
claims.statement_id: Quetzalcoatl mengenakan perhiasan dada permata angin ehecacozcatl yang terbuat dari potongan cangkang keong.
claims.quote: Quetzalcoatl wears around his neck the breastplate ehēcacōzcatl , "the spirally voluted wind jewel". This talisman was a conch shell cut at the cross-section

claims.statement: Following the Spanish conquest of the Aztec Empire, records conflated Quetzalcoatl with Ce Acatl Topiltzin, ruler of Tollan.
claims.statement_id: Setelah penaklukan Spanyol atas Kekaisaran Aztek, catatan sejarah kerap memadukan Quetzalcoatl dengan Ce Acatl Topiltzin, penguasa kota Tollan.
claims.quote: In the era following the 16th-century Spanish conquest of the Aztec Empire , a number of records conflated Quetzalcoatl with Ce Acatl Topiltzin , a ruler of the mythico-historic city of Tollan .

claims.statement: The civilization of Teotihuacan was the first to adopt the feathered serpent as a major symbol, notably at the Quetzalcoatl temple.
claims.statement_id: Peradaban Teotihuacan merupakan kebudayaan pertama yang memakai simbol ular berbulu, terutama pada Kuil Quetzalcoatl.
claims.quote: The first culture to use the symbol of a feathered serpent as an important religious and political symbol was that of Teotihuacan . At temples such as the aptly named "Quetzalcoatl temple" in the Ciudadela complex, feathered serpents figure prominently

claims.statement: Quetzalcoatl was the god of winds and rain, and the creator of the world and humanity.
claims.statement_id: Quetzalcoatl adalah dewa angin dan hujan, serta pencipta dunia dan umat manusia.
claims.quote: Quetzalcóatl was the god of winds and rain, and the creator of the world and humanity.

claims.statement: A mix of bird and rattlesnake, his name is a combination of the Nahuatl words quetzal and coatl.
claims.statement_id: Sebagai perpaduan burung dan ular derik, namanya gabungan dari kata Nahuatl quetzal dan coatl.
claims.quote: A mix of bird and rattlesnake, his name is a combination of the Nahuatl words quetzal (the emerald plumed bird) and coatl (serpent).

claims.statement: In Central Mexico from 1200, the feathered serpent god was considered the patron god of priests, merchants, learning, agriculture, and arts.
claims.statement_id: Di Meksiko Tengah dari tahun 1200, ia dipuja sebagai pelindung imam, pedagang, ilmu, pertanian, dan kesenian.
claims.quote: In Central Mexico from 1200, the feathered serpent god was considered the patron god of priests and merchants as well as the god of learning, science , agriculture , crafts and the arts.

claims.statement: He also invented the calendar, was identified with the Morning Star Venus, and discovered corn.
claims.statement_id: Ia juga menciptakan kalender, diidentifikasi dengan bintang fajar Venus, dan menemukan jagung.
claims.quote: He also invented the calendar, was identified with the Morning Star Venus , the rising morning star, he was associated with opossums and even discovered corn (maize)

claims.statement: In Postclassical Nahua tradition, Quetzalcoatl was the creator of the cosmos along with his brother Tezcatlipoca.
claims.statement_id: Dalam tradisi Nahua, Quetzalcoatl adalah pencipta kosmos bersama saudaranya Tezcatlipoca atau Huitzilopochtli.
claims.quote: In Postclassical Nahua tradition Quetzalcóatl is also the creator of the cosmos along with either his brother Tezcatlipoca or Huitzilopochtli

claims.statement: He was known as Kukulkan to the Maya, Gucumatz to the Quiche of Guatemala, and Ehecatl to the coastal peoples.
claims.statement_id: Ia dikenal sebagai Kukulkan bagi bangsa Maya, Gucumatz bagi suku Kiche di Guatemala, dan Ehecatl di pesisir.
claims.quote: He was known as Kukulkán to the Maya , Gucumatz to the Quiché of Guatemala, and Ehecatl to the Gulf Coast Huastecs.

claims.statement: On a lone voyage, he went to find the bones of the dead in the underworld, known as Mictlan.
claims.statement_id: Dalam perjalanan seorang diri, ia pergi mencari tulang-belulang orang mati di alam baka Mictlan.
claims.quote: On a lone voyage, he went to find the bones of the dead in the underworld, known as Mictlan.

claims.statement: After many trials and tribulations he was able to escape Mictlan and carry the bones to Tamoanchan, home of the gods.
claims.statement_id: Setelah berbagai ujian berat, ia berhasil lolos dari Mictlan dan membawa tulang tersebut ke Tamoanchan kediaman para dewa.
claims.quote: After many trials and tribulations he was able to escape Mictlan and carry the bones to Tamoanchan, home of the gods.

claims.statement: He ground the bones and mixed them with his blood, creating the first humans of the current era.
claims.statement_id: Ia menumbuk tulang tersebut dan mencampurkannya dengan darahnya sendiri untuk menciptakan manusia pertama.
claims.quote: He ground the bones and mixed them with his blood, creating the first humans of the 5th (and current) sun.

claims.statement: From the smoking remains rose the morning star, Venus, who is represented by Quetzalcoatl in his guise of Tlahuizcalpantecuhtli.
claims.statement_id: Dari sisa api pengorbanan terbitlah bintang fajar Venus yang diwakili Quetzalcoatl dalam wujud Tlahuizcalpantecuhtli.
claims.quote: From the smoking remains rose the morning star, Venus, who is represented by Quetzalcoatl in his guise of Tlahuizcalpantecuhtli.

claims.statement: Images of serpents have been represented in Mesoamerican art since Olmec times, and are related to fertility and the earth.
claims.statement_id: Citra ular telah hadir dalam seni rupa Mesoamerika sejak zaman Olmec dan berkaitan erat dengan kesuburan serta bumi.
claims.quote: Images of serpents have been represented in Mesoamerican art since Olmec times, and we know that they are related to fertility and the earth.

claims.statement: Quetzalcoatl and Tezcatlipoca were brothers in divine myths, where they worked together as creators, and against each other in acts of destruction.
claims.statement_id: Quetzalcoatl dan Tezcatlipoca bersaudara dalam mitos dewa, bekerja sama sebagai pencipta dan saling bersaing dalam penghancuran.
claims.quote: Quetzalcoatl and Tezcatlipoca were brothers in divine myths, where they worked together as creators, and against each other in acts of destruction.

claims.statement: Krasue is a nocturnal female spirit of Southeast Asian folklore manifesting as a floating head with trailing internal organs.
claims.statement_id: Krasue adalah roh wanita nokturnal dalam cerita rakyat Asia Tenggara yang berwujud kepala melayang dengan organ dalam menjuntai.
claims.quote: is a nocturnal female spirit of Southeast Asian folklore . It manifests as the floating, disembodied head of a woman, usually young and beautiful, with her internal organs still attached and trailing down from the neck.

claims.statement: According to Thai ethnographer Phraya Anuman Rajadhon, the Krasue is accompanied by a will-o'-the-wisp-like luminescent glow.
claims.statement_id: Menurut etnografer Thai, Krasue disertai oleh pendaran cahaya mirip api rawa.
claims.quote: According to Thai ethnographer Phraya Anuman Rajadhon , the Krasue is accompanied by a will-o'-the-wisp -like luminescent glow.

claims.statement: She hides the headless body in a quiet place needing to rejoin it before daybreak, living normally by day.
claims.statement_id: Ia menyembunyikan tubuh tanpa kepala di tempat sepi karena harus menyatu kembali sebelum fajar.
claims.quote: hides the headless body from which it originates in a quiet place because it needs to join it before daybreak, living like a normal person during the day, although having a sleepy look.

claims.statement: Crushing the headless body of the krasue proves fatal to the spirit.
claims.statement_id: Menghancurkan tubuh tanpa kepala milik krasue berakibat fatal bagi roh tersebut.
claims.quote: To crush the still headless body of the krasue is fatal to the spirit.

claims.statement: To protect pregnant women and children from becoming victims, relatives place thorny branches around the house as a barrier.
claims.statement_id: Untuk melindungi wanita hamil dan anak-anak, kerabat meletakkan ranting berduri di sekeliling rumah sebagai perintang.
claims.quote: In order to protect pregnant women and their children from becoming victims, their relatives place thorny branches around the house as a barrier.

claims.statement: These regional variations all share in common being characterized by a disembodied woman's head with organs and entrails hanging from the neck.
claims.statement_id: Berbagai variasi daerah ini memiliki kesamaan berupa wujud kepala wanita melayang dengan organ dan isi perut menjuntai.
claims.quote: these regional variations all share in common that they are characterized by a disembodied woman's head with organs and entrails hanging from its neck.

claims.statement: Floating in the air in rural parts of Thailand and the rest of Southeast Asia, the disembodied ghost of the Krasue hunts for blood.
claims.statement_id: Melayang di udara pedesaan Thailand dan bagian lain Asia Tenggara, hantu Krasue berburu darah.
claims.quote: Floating in the air in rural parts of Thailand and the rest of Southeast Asia, the disembodied ghost of the Krasue is hunting for blood.

claims.statement: Across Cambodia, Thailand, Laos, and parts of Malaysia, villagers share a haunting vision living in whispered folklore.
claims.statement_id: Di Kamboja, Thailand, Laos, dan sebagian Malaysia, warga desa berbagi kisah cerita rakyat tentang makhluk ini.
claims.quote: Across Cambodia, Thailand, Laos, and parts of Malaysia, villagers share a haunting vision that lives in whispered folklore.

claims.statement: Krasue is a night creature that floats, haunting fields, villages, and the spaces of human life.
claims.statement_id: Krasue adalah makhluk malam yang melayang, menghantui ladang, desa, dan ruang kehidupan manusia.
claims.quote: Krasue is a night creature that floats, haunting fields, villages, and the spaces between human life and the unseen world.

claims.statement: The core of the legend remains consistent that Krasue is a detached head with internal organs trailing below like shimmering tendrils.
claims.statement_id: Inti legenda tetap sama di mana Krasue adalah kepala terpisah dengan organ dalam menjuntai di bawahnya.
claims.quote: While exact details differ by region, the core of the legend remains consistent: Krasue is a detached head with its internal organs trailing below like shimmering tendrils.

claims.statement: Her head glows faintly in the dark, often compared to a flickering lamp or will-o'-the-wisp floating in the air.
claims.statement_id: Kepalanya berpendar samar di kegelapan mirip lentera atau api rawa saat melayang di udara.
claims.quote: Her head glows faintly in the dark, often compared to a flickering lamp or a will-o’-the-wisp, floating in the air.

claims.statement: Witches can turn into a Krasue, or the condition passes to daughters or granddaughters as an ancestral curse.
claims.statement_id: Penyihir wanita dapat berubah menjadi Krasue, atau kutukan tersebut menurun kepada putri dan cucu perempuannya.
claims.quote: These witches and witchcraft are also called “Mae Mot" (แม่มด) or " Yai Mot" (ยายมด). If not the witch turned into a Krasue herself, her daughters or granddaughters could, like an ancestral curse.

claims.statement: This entity bears varied regional names including Penanggalan, Krasue, Kasu, Manananggal, Palasik, and Ahp.
claims.statement_id: Sosok ini memiliki beragam nama daerah seperti Penanggalan, Krasue, Kasu, Manananggal, Palasik, dan Ahp.
claims.quote: Penanggalan (Malaysia & Indonesia) Balan-balan (Malaysia & Indonesia) Krasue (Thailand) Kasu (Laos) Manananggal (Philippines) Palasik (Sumatra) Leyak (Bali) Ma Lai (Vietnam) Ahp (Cambodia)

claims.statement: Others claim it is a woman practicing black magic, meditating while submerged in a vat of vinegar.
claims.statement_id: Sebagian meyakini sosok ini adalah wanita pelaku ilmu hitam yang bertapa terendam dalam cuka.
claims.quote: Others claim it is a woman who practices black magic, meditating while submerged in a vat of vinegar.

claims.statement: At night, her head along with entrails detaches from her body, hunting for pregnant women and newborn children.
claims.statement_id: Pada malam hari, kepalanya bersama isi perut terlepas dari tubuhnya dan berburu wanita hamil serta anak baru lahir.
claims.quote: At night, her head, along with her entrails, detaches from her body, and she goes hunting for pregnant women and newborn children.

claims.statement: The word penanggalan derives from the Malay root word tanggal, meaning to detach or remove.
claims.statement_id: Kata penanggalan berasal dari kata dasar bahasa Melayu tanggal yang bermakna melepaskan atau menanggalkan.
claims.quote: To look at the origin of the penanggalan word, it comes from the Malay root word 'tanggal', meaning "to detach" or "to remove"

claims.statement: The body remains hidden, often soaking in vinegar to preserve it while the head hunts.
claims.statement_id: Tubuhnya tetap tersembunyi dan kerap direndam dalam cuka agar tetap awet sementara kepalanya berburu.
claims.quote: The body remains hidden, often soaking in vinegar to preserve it while the head hunts.

claims.statement: This legend appears consistently throughout Laos, Cambodia, Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia, and the Philippines.
claims.statement_id: Legenda ini muncul secara konsisten di Laos, Kamboja, Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia, dan Filipina.
claims.quote: This legend appears consistently throughout Laos, Cambodia, Thailand, Malaysia, Indonesia, and the Philippines.
